stem:
Ira uses a lifting electromagnet on a yard crane to move iron rods.

When the current in the electromagnet is switched ON, what happens to the iron rods, and what happens when the current is switched OFF?

teacher.key_rationale: A lifting electromagnet picks up iron while current is ON and releases it when current is OFF. Plastic is not lifted. Holding after OFF confuses electromagnet with permanent magnet.
